desc: Properly implement the sweep with correct tracking of top two pairs (both values and their indices)
When updating, handle ties (new a == L1 or L2) correctly — tie-breaking keeps the first pair encountered as the attributed max
Compute baseline as sum(i - L1) and per-pair gain when L1 > L2 (gain is L1 - L2)
Find the maximum gain across all pairs; if no pair yields a positive gain, max_gain = 0
Test with provided examples (n=4, pairs=[[2,3],[1,4]] -> 9; n=5, pairs=[[1,2],[2,5],[3,5]] -> 12)
Test edge cases: n=2, single pair, all pairs overlapping, no overlapping pairs
Verify complexity is O(n + m) and fits constraints
